fact: The Plano Estratégico da Educação 2022-2026, first edition July 2023, names SIGE in its costed action plan: 4,000,000 escudos over three years for consolidating SIGE as the sector's administrative and academic management platform and 2,000,000 for a portaria regulating its use, both under DGCTM/DGPOG, with a target of 100% of non-higher education establishments using SIGE; it lists the technical management and evolutive maintenance of SIGE as a ministry function and records as a weakness that SIGE is not in effect in technical schools.
title: Plano Estratégico da Educação 2022-2026
